newsitem.title: POLAND: CA-LEASING POLAND TO ISSUE PLN 100 MLN CPS.
newsitem.headline: CA-LEASING POLAND TO ISSUE PLN 100 MLN CPS.

text.p: CA-Leasing Poland plans to issue up to 100 million zlotys of commercial papers with maturities from seven days to one-year under a three-year programme, the issue's agent Creditanstalt Securities SA said on Friday.

CA-Leasing Poland, equally-owned by Creditanstalt SA in Warsaw and Austria's CA-Leasing GmbH, placed on Friday the first tranche of three-month notes worth five million zlotys with a group of domestic and foreign investors.
The issue's agent, Creditanstalt Securities SA, did not give the yield at which the paper, due on May 5, 1997, was allocated. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
